A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the brain cells, neurons and astrocyte cells, have the capacity to use glucose and lactate as major metabolic fuels, and that the use of these two substrates is not mutually exclusive, but rather that they are complementary.
lactate spares glucose metabolism in neurons, and that lactate and glucose metabolism are coupled in astrocytes.
